title: Credit Cards
intro: Compare popular Indian credit cards on fees, real value-back, forex markup and lounge access: pick the card whose rewards match where you actually spend, and whose fee you can get waived.
sources: Card issuer product pages and MITC / fees & charges (checked Oct 2026)

params.label: Annual fee
params.tip: Renewal fee excl. GST, as of Oct 2026.

params.label: Fee waiver spend
params.tip: Annual spend that waives the renewal fee (Oct 2026).

params.label: Base reward rate
params.tip: Value back on everyday spends at the stated redemption value (Oct 2026).

params.label: Best category reward
params.tip: Highest value back on bonus categories or partners, usually capped (Oct 2026).

params.label: Forex markup
params.tip: Charged on foreign-currency spends, plus GST (Oct 2026).

params.label: Domestic lounge visits / yr
params.tip: Complimentary visits a year; often need a spend milestone (Oct 2026).

params.label: Fuel surcharge waiver
params.tip: 1% waiver on eligible fuel spends, capped (Oct 2026).

params.label: Interest per month
params.tip: Finance charge on unpaid balance, per month (Oct 2026).

params.label: Best for
params.tip: Spend type the card rewards most.

items.name: HDFC Bank Infinia Metal

v.waiver: Renewal fee waived on Rs 10 lakh spend in the preceding 12 months

pros: 5 RP per Rs 150 (3.33% at Re 1/RP on flights/hotels via SmartBuy)
Up to 10X on SmartBuy (capped 15,000 RP/month) - 33.33% at Re 1/RP
Unlimited lounge (domestic and international, primary and add-on)
Low 2% forex markup; 1.99%/month interest
cons: By invitation only
SmartBuy voucher earning capped at 3,000 RP/month from July 2026
Points worth only up to Rs 0.50 on vouchers/products and Rs 0.30 as cashback
items.best: High-income spenders who book travel through SmartBuy

items.name: HDFC Bank Regalia Gold

v.waiver: Renewal fee waived on Rs 4 lakh spend in a year

pros: 5 RP per Rs 200 (1.63% at Rs 0.65/RP on Gold catalogue)
5X on Myntra, Nykaa, Reliance Digital and more (8.13% at Rs 0.65/RP)
6 Priority Pass international lounge visits a year; 2% forex
Rs 5,000 flight vouchers at Rs 5 lakh and Rs 7.5 lakh annual spend
cons: Domestic lounge (3 per quarter) needs Rs 60,000 spend in the previous quarter
Points worth only Rs 0.50 on flights/hotels and Rs 0.35 on vouchers
Reward earn capped at 50,000 RP per statement cycle
items.best: Mid-to-high spenders wanting lounge access and travel vouchers

items.name: HDFC Bank Millennia

v.waiver: Annual fee waived on Rs 1 lakh spend in a year

pros: 5% CashPoints on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato, Uber, BookMyShow and more
1% on other spends; 1 CashPoint = Re 1 against statement
Low Rs 1 lakh spend for fee waiver
cons: 5% and 1% tiers each capped at 1,000 CashPoints/month
Statement redemption min 500, max 3,000 points/month; Rs 0.30 on other options
Lounge only as a choice (1 visit or Rs 1,000 voucher) on Rs 1 lakh quarterly spend; 3.5% forex
items.best: Online shoppers who use the partner apps

items.name: Swiggy HDFC Bank Credit Card

v.waiver: Renewal fee waived on Rs 2 lakh spend in a year

pros: 10% cashback on Swiggy (food, Instamart, Dineout, Genie), up to Rs 1,500/month
5% on online spends (up to Rs 1,500) and 1% elsewhere (up to Rs 500)
Cashback credited to statement; 3 months Swiggy One on joining
cons: No airport lounge access
No cashback on fuel, rent, EMI, wallet, jewellery, government
3.5% forex markup
items.best: Heavy Swiggy users

items.name: Tata Neu Infinity HDFC Bank Credit Card

v.waiver: Annual fee waived on Rs 3 lakh spend in a year
v.bestFor: Tata Neu, BigBasket, Croma and other Tata brands

pros: 5% NeuCoins on Tata Neu and partner brands, up to 10% with NeuPass offers
1.5% on non-Tata spends; 1 NeuCoin = Re 1

No NeuCoins on fuel, wallet, rent, government, gaming; caps on grocery, utility, telecom, insurance
NeuCoins only usable within Tata ecosystem
items.best: Regular Tata ecosystem shoppers
items.news: Tata Neu Infinity HDFC credit card

items.name: SBI Card CASHBACK

items.name: SBI Card ELITE

v.waiver: Annual fee waived on Rs 10 lakh spend in a year

pros: Rs 5,000 welcome vouchers

Free movie tickets worth up to Rs 6,000 a year

items.name: ICICI Bank Coral

items.name: Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card

Fee waiver needs Rs 3.5 lakh spend
3.5% forex markup

items.name: Axis Bank Atlas

Miles transfer to airline and hotel partners

Rs 99-199 redemption fee per transaction
3.5% forex markup

items.name: Axis Bank Magnus

v.waiver: Annual fee waived on Rs 25 lakh spend in the preceding year

pros: Welcome voucher worth Rs 12,500
12 RP per Rs 200 (1.2% at Rs 0.20/RP); 35 RP per Rs 200 above Rs 1.5 lakh/month (3.5%); 5X via Travel EDGE (6%)
Unlimited lounge (international via Priority Pass; domestic)
2% forex; 3%/month interest

No points on insurance, gold/jewellery, fuel

items.name: Axis Bank ACE

v.waiver: Annual fee waived on Rs 2 lakh spend in a year

Unlimited 1.5% on other spends
4 domestic lounge visits a year

Many exclusions: rent, wallet, education, insurance, fuel, jewellery, government
T&Cs revised from 28 Aug 2026; 3.5% forex

items.name: IDFC FIRST Wealth

v.waiver: Lifetime free

pros: Lifetime free with zero forex markup on all IDFC FIRST cards from 9 Sep 2026
10X points (10 RP per Rs 200, about 1.25% at Rs 0.25/RP) on dining, travel, international and birthday spends from the first rupee since June 2026
1 domestic + 1 international airport lounge visit per quarter
1% fuel surcharge waiver
cons: Base 3 RP per Rs 200 = about 0.38% (Rs 0.25/RP)
Lounge and movie benefits need Rs 20,000 spend in the previous month
Points now expire after 24 months; Rs 99 + GST redemption fee
Earn base moved from Rs 150 to Rs 200 per point in Jan 2026

items.name: IDFC FIRST Select

v.waiver: Lifetime free
v.bestFor: no-fee everyday card with zero forex

pros: Lifetime free; zero forex markup from 9 Sep 2026
10 RP per Rs 200 (about 1.25% at Rs 0.25/RP) on dining, travel and international with no spend threshold since June 2026
1% fuel surcharge waiver (up to Rs 300 per cycle)
Railway lounge access and roadside assistance
cons: Base 3 RP per Rs 200 = about 0.38%
Only 1 domestic airport lounge visit per quarter, needs Rs 20,000 monthly spend; no international lounge
Points expire after 24 months
No points on fuel, EMI or cash

items.name: IDFC FIRST Millennia

v.waiver: Lifetime free
v.bestFor: first credit card, dining and travel

Fuel surcharge waiver and movie discount

No airport lounge access

Fuel surcharge waiver via Rs 49 pack

Benefits cost extra and packs auto-renew; 5% cashback pack capped
High 3.49% forex markup
Lounge only via paid pack

High income bar (about Rs 2.5 lakh per month)
